description: Purpose: fetch one regulation record in full - issuing body, policy type, scope, impact on the rCB industry, compliance deadline, source link and an AI-readable summary. Guidelines: accepts the id from query_policies(rcb-pol-xxx) or a name/identifier keyword such as 'CBAM' or '2023/956'; run query_policies first when the id is unknown; add response_format='json' for agent pipelines. Limits: one record per call; no legal opinion and no applicability assessment for a given company, product or shipment. Ex: get_policy(id='rcb-pol-001'), get_policy(name='CBAM'), get_policy(name='2023/956', language='en').

name.description: 名称关键词或文号（与 id 二选一），如 'CBAM'、'2023/956'

response_format.description: 输出格式：markdown=人类阅读, json=Agent 处理友好

name: get_policy

text.description: Human-readable result (markdown, or a JSON string when response_format=json).
